notes: Fixed: when all providers are down while the local model is starting up, the bot now waits for the model to load and answers instead of failing the message — and the “Launch at Login” toggle now really applies in both directions.
notes_zh: 修复：当所有提供方不可用且本地模型正在启动时，机器人会等待模型加载完成后再回答，不再让消息失败——并且“开机自动启动”开关现在双向真正生效。
